title: Monitoring Distributed Systems
versionOrDate: Site Reliability Engineering online book, 2016 edition; reviewed 2026-08-02
relevance: Primary Google SRE chapter for why teams monitor, how black-box and white-box evidence differ, why symptoms and causes must not be confused, and how latency, traffic, errors and saturation organize service monitoring. Its 2016 examples are methodology, not current product behavior or a complete service-level objective policy.
